title: Certificate Lifecycle, Multi-brand Builds, and Environments Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies certificate lifecycle, multi-brand builds, and environments?
options: Inventory each identity separately, validate typed variants, rehearse overlapping rotation, and prevent cross-environment data or credential flow.
questions.answer: Inventory each identity separately, validate typed variants, rehearse overlapping rotation, and prevent cross-environment data or credential flow.
questions.explanation: The correct response preserves authority, compatibility, exact artifact evidence, adverse-path behavior, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: The Play upload certificate is the signing identity observed by every user-installed Play APK.
questions.explanation: Changing a production endpoint with an in-app hidden switch can route real credentials and data into an unapproved environment.

questions.prompt: Why deploy new certificate trust before using the new certificate?
questions.answer: An overlap window lets old clients or servers accept both identities while deployment and adoption complete.
questions.explanation: The answer identifies the contract or mechanism that remains valid beyond one implementation demonstration.
